about: Ready your blade - grueling encounters await around every corner in this action RPG in a vast land ravaged by civil war.
To triumph you'll need patience, to learn where each foe - human or demon - is strong, and when to strike at their weaknesses.
Embrace every defeat as a step along the path to victory. Only in death will you find the way of the samurai.
summary: Ready to die? Experience the newest brutal action game from Team NINJA and Koei Tecmo Games. In the age of samurai, a lone traveler lands on the shores of Japan. He must fight his way through the vicious warriors and supernatural Yokai that infest…
